prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cute fox-like aquatic Teenieping mascot for MyStarQuest using the attached Primarina-Ping as the template for proportions and polished 3D rendering.
The reference supplies the enormous rounded head, tiny torso, expressive glossy eyes, curled mermaid lower body and overall charming toy-like finish. Design a DIFFERENT character using generic aquatic-fox archetypes.
Character design: a softly rounded pale aqua face with subtle cream fox-cheek markings, a tiny rounded fox muzzle and little dark nose, huge glossy sapphire eyes, rosy cheeks and a joyful friendly smile. Two upright rounded triangular fox ears, soft lavender-blue on the outside and pearly apricot inside, with small fanlike fin extensions along their outer edges. A short sculpted wavy cobalt-to-turquoise forelock curls over the forehead. No long ponytail or pearl chain.
Flared gills form two delicate translucent lavender fans behind the cheeks, separate from the ears. Short pale teal torso with two tiny flipper-like arms, one waving. A small white belly medallion carries a gold ripple emblem. The lower body flows into a compact curving mermaid tail, aqua with deep indigo shading along the upper edge, and three soft rounded dorsal fins. Tail ends in two broad translucent lavender and turquoise fin lobes. Keep the sea-fox features gentle and rounded, no sharp threatening teeth or spikes.
This is a coherent little aquatic fox spirit, not a human wearing a costume. Keep the Primarina-Ping template's giant head-to-tiny-body ratio, soft sculpted forms, luminous eyes and clear silhouette. Different hairstyle, ear shape, colors and ornaments from the template; no pink star ornament, pearls or crown.
Full body nearly frontal three-quarter view, head slightly tilted, curved tail arranged beside body, both arms visible. Entire ears, gill fans, hair and tail inside frame with generous transparent margin. Premium polished 3D children's animated mascot, soft studio lighting, pearly smooth surfaces, playful friendly expression. Single character isolated on a genuine transparent background, no scenery, text, watermark, additional creatures or props.
